text:
Elena (CS): quick heads-up — weekly acct health check for Helio Labs. I pulled the hosted usage and there are a couple of flags we should triage before renewal ping.
Sam (Account): thanks. what are the top flags?
Elena (CS): 1) spend vs commit: they have a $25k/mo commit, current projected burn for month ~ $21.8k but last 48h spike pushed projected to $28.6k if trend continues. 2) anomaly flags: repeated short bursts from a single api-key (prod-api-key-helio) — ~3x usual qps windows. 3) perf: p95 latency up from 210ms to 420ms on hosted-us-west.
Marta (Support): seeing increased 500s on their POST /v1/generate route around the same time window. Error rate jumped from 0.3% -> 1.6% (24h).
Ravi (Ops): infra-bot: `route: hosted-us-west` shows CPU tail at 86% and GPU utilization consistent with batch growth. Might be auto-batching causing contention.
infra-bot: automated alert — hostpool-us-west-2 overlay crossed CPU 80% for > 6m. Related incidents: none open.
billing-bot: usage-alert: projected monthly spend exceeded commit by 14% based on last 48h trend. See dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/helio-labs/projected
Sam (Account): hmm, risk for renewal if they exceed commit. Do we have a recommended mitigation?
Elena (CS): my suggested immediate steps: a) reach out to customer ops to confirm expected spike (Sam to own outreach) b) set temporary rate cap on the offending key (Ravi to implement per policy) c) enable prefix/KV caching suggestion and decrease batch window for their typical seq lengths (Ravi + DevEx) d) schedule an enablement session on cost controls and dashboard walkthrough (Sam + Elena)
Ravi (Ops): I can throttle at the gateway for that api-key to soft-limit to 120 rps for 1h, escalate if they push back. Also will turn on per-route debug logging for 15m to capture error traces.
Marta (Support): I'll correlate error traces with request payload sizes and client-side retry behavior. Any recent model rollouts on their account?
Elena (CS): none on our side. They were testing a larger context window client-side yesterday per logs. Could explain cost + KV pressure.
Sam (Account): I'm going to ping their engineering lead now. cc @Elena (CS) — will share our findings and propose a joint call.
Elena (CS): action items: Sam — customer outreach + renewal note; Ravi — put soft throttle + collect logs; Marta — error root cause correlates; me — prepare short enablement deck (cost controls + quick fixes). Target: have update by EOD PST.
Ravi (Ops): running quick query to get 48h usage by api-key:```sql
SELECT api_key, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as calls
FROM hosted_requests
WHERE ts > now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY api_key
ORDER BY tokens desc
LIMIT 10;
```
Marta (Support): thanks — that will help.
Elena (CS): also flagging for renewal risk — if projection holds we'll need to convert them to a bumped commit or open overage discussion. Let's avoid surprise billing.
Sam (Account): noted. I'll suggest a temporary overage buffer + runbook: 1) throttle 2) joint call 3) offer short-term commit bump with 30-day review.
infra-bot: deploybot: canary rollback not necessary — no model infra deploys detected in window.
Ravi (Ops): implemented soft throttle for `prod-api-key-helio` at 120 rps at 2280001400. Monitoring now.
Elena (CS): perfect. Please post a follow-up in this thread when error rate drops below 0.6% or after 1h.
Marta (Support): initial correlation: 70% of 500s correlate with payloads > 4k tokens, which maps to their new client config. Suggest recommending smaller chunking or streaming.
Sam (Account): update: Helio replied — they were running an experiment that accidentally ramped in prod. They're open to a call. Scheduling for tomorrow 10am PT.
Elena (CS): great. I will prep a 15-min deck: spend projection, quick mitigations (throttle, caching, context window), renewal options.
Ravi (Ops): current metrics: p95 latency down to 310ms after throttle, error rate 0.9%. Will re-check in 30m.
Marta (Support): I'll draft the logs summary and attach to the meeting invite.
Sam (Account): +1. Thanks team.
Elena (CS): closing loop: final ask — if the throttle/enablement doesn't bring them under commit in 72h, we propose a temporary commit bump or structured overage credit. Keep notes here. :thumbsup:
